description: Exploit: spend Muon's margin on resize, the cheapest accuracy-for-time lever. Resize costs ~0.4 pp/s (E008/E013/E018); cutting epochs costs ~0.75 pp/s (E020). Start from the I032 result if it was kept as the fused-Muon base, otherwise from E025 (commit 50d39d6: E024 tip plus Muon on the block conv filters, lr 0.24, momentum 0.6, 11 ep, batch 1536). Change only the 24 px fraction, from the first 50% of steps to the first 75% (bilinear antialias=True after flip and translate, LR/Lookahead/Muon schedules still tied to step count). Both shapes stay compiled and graphed in build, with no recompile in timed train. Report per-seed accuracy. This is the head-to-head alternative to I033 (epoch cut) for spending the same margin; if both run, compare pp lost per second saved.
